title: TAI agro-wide live acceptance evidence hardening
objective: Make the broad agricultural live acceptance deterministic, evidence-complete and vocabulary-tolerant without weakening subject relevance, fail-open agro routing or fail-closed security boundaries.
boundaries: The production route remains model-first for every safe agricultural or agribusiness question
No application routing, authorization, tenant isolation, write authority, secret handling or model identity logic is changed
The live validator must persist the full answer evidence before applying quality assertions so failures are diagnosable
A substantive answer must mention the actual subject, avoid platform-security misrouting and match at least two domain concept groups
Concept groups may include professional synonyms and equivalent operational terms; a closed single-word vocabulary must not create false failures
Short, refusal-only, unrelated, fabricated-operation or platform-boilerplate answers remain hard failures
RU remains mandatory with representative EN and ZH coverage
Exact-main manifest, local Qwen identity, general_agro mode, direct SSE and 390x844 mobile UI remain mandatory
No paid model, SaaS, database, hosting service or recurring cost is added
Production completion still requires merge, canonical images, REG.RU exact-main rollout, TAI preflight, activation, finalization and live evidence PASS
